stemMarkdown: The speeds of A and B are in the ratio 8 : 6. In a 800 m race, how many metres of a head start must A give B so that the race ends in a dead heat? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: In the time A covers 800 m, B covers $800 \times \dfrac{6}{8} = 600.0000$ m. For a tie, B must be started ahead by the shortfall: $200.0$ m.
